arguments.message: Additional fact: the item is unused. Re-evaluate using only supplied facts.

payload.reply: {"status": "need_info", "result": "The supplied policy requires two objective conditions: (1) the refund request must be within 7 days of purchase, and (2) the refund amount must be below SGD 100. The newly supplied fact that the item is 'unused' is not a criterion in the supplied policy and therefore neither approves nor blocks the refund on its own — it is neutral unless another policy clause (not provided) makes condition of the item relevant. As of now, neither the 7-day window nor the sub-SGD-100 amount has been established from supplied facts, so the policy test cannot be passed or failed. I cannot decide 'meets policy' without these data points and will not invent them.", "missing": "Still missing: purchase date, refund request date (to verify the 7-day window), and refund amount in SGD (to verify it is below SGD 100). The 'unused' status alone is insufficient under the supplied policy."}
